note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source contains no worker description, hence only the soldier and alate sections; the soldier section has letter misreadings from OCR but the measurements are complete; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule broadly oval, mandibles stout, about half the head length, the proximal half of the left mandible with 3 small denticles and the right mandible without denticles. Alate compound eyes large and markedly protruding, antennal segment 3 the shortest.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; labrum paler than the head capsule; remainder of the body straw yellow. Head and pronotum with a few scattered setae, abdomen slightly more hairy. Body length 5.0–5.40 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, sides weakly narrowing anteriorly, widest near the middle (length to mandibular base 1.36–1.60 mm, maximum width 1.14–1.27 mm). Antennae 16–17-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum broad, ligulate; anterior margin broadly rounded; sides with rather long setae. Mandibles strong, stout, about half the head length (length 0.70–0.79 mm). Proximal half of the left mandible with 3 small denticles; right mandible without denticles. Postmentum subquadrate (length 0.79–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.39–0.48 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly to distinctly concave, posterior margin distinctly notched (length 0.48–0.60 mm, width 0.90–1.01 mm). Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, metanotum wider than the pronotum; posterior margins of both nearly straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; labrum brownish; antennae light brown; abdomen light brown dorsally. Head and body rather densely hairy. Head subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.58 mm, width including compound eyes 2.37 mm). Fontanelle a small, round whitish spot (diameter 0.08 mm). Compound eyes large, broadly oval (maximum diameter 0.72 mm, minimum diameter 0.58 mm), markedly protruding. Ocellus elliptical, semi-transparent (long diameter 0.31 mm, short diameter 0.26 mm), separated from the compound eye by slightly more than half its long diameter (ocellus–compound eye distance 0.17 mm). Antennae incomplete, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 the shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, less than half as long as wide (length 0.37 mm, width 0.88 mm). Pronotum trapezoidal (length 1.05 mm, width 2.02 mm); anterior margin slightly raised, distinctly notched medially; posterior margin nearly straight.
